ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of Clerk (02 Posts) on a Daily
Wage Basis, purely on a contract basis at D.C. rates, for a period of 89 days, which may be
extended as per the requirement at Panjab University Regional Centre, Ludhiana.
Terms and Conditions:
1. Educational Qualifications:
o Graduation or equivalent, by way of academic qualifications, computer literacy
(as distinct from computer specialization).
2. Age Limit:
o Candidates must be between 18 to 37 years of age.
o Relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates.
o Relaxation of 10 years for physically handicapped candidates.
3. For Ex Servicemen and other categories P.U Chandigarh rules may be referred.
Application Submission: Interested candidates should submit their applications in the
prescribed format, along with the following documents (02 sets of copies):
 Self-attested copies of educational/professional qualifications (degrees, DMCs, and
conversion formula for CGPA/OGPA), Experience certificate (if any).
These documents should be submitted either by hand or post to the Director, Panjab
University Regional Centre, Fountain Chowk, Civil Lines, Opp. Pavilion Mall,
Ludhiana-141001, by 28th March 2025 before 5:00 PM. Applications sent via email, fax,
or any other mode will not be accepted.
No TA/DA will be given for the said purpose
